intro.title: Build a typeahead autocomplete box
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a typeahead autocomplete box—a search input that suggests matching options as the user types. You'll learn how to filter an array of data based on user input to display real-time suggestions. The main technologies involved are JavaScript arrays, string methods, and DOM event handling for input changes. This project will help you understand dynamic UI updates and basic search functionality in a web application.
intro.usecase: Typeahead autocomplete is essential for modern user interfaces where quick search and data entry are required. You'll find this pattern in e-commerce search bars that suggest products as you type, form fields that auto-complete addresses or email addresses, and dashboard filters that help users narrow down large datasets. As a developer, implementing this feature improves user experience by reducing typing effort, preventing input errors, and helping users discover available options faster. This skill is valuable for building responsive search interfaces, smart form components, and interactive data exploration tools.
